title: Crystal Thinks Fighting Cops Will Fix Her Crashed Car
description:
A New Jersey woman was arrested after allegedly causing a DUI crash before lunging at an officer. Police confronted Crystal Beverly, 35, at the scene of the crash where she became belligerent with police saying she would ‘punch’ them in the face, according to the Westfield Police Department. Officers tried to reason with Beverly but the body cam video shows the scene quickly escalated.  The 35-year-old is not facing multiple charges.
